name: bulwark
description: Bulwark — deterministic, non-generative visual design QA engine (OmniDiff)

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @bulwark/cli run build && pnpm --filter @bulwark/api run build && pnpm --filter @bulwark/dashboard run build
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
